changes: made final DST closeness to Gold State the primary outcome as a graded per-episode score, and demoted exact match to a reported strictest cut
added the paired final-state closeness improvement over the v1.3 contract on identical raw proposals as the second primary
pre-registered a comparative decision rule and recorded why no absolute threshold is set
enabled the pre-registered test-retest run as Analysis C and fixed the Run A primary versus Run B robustness roles
required Run A and Run B to execute back to back before either result is opened
forbade averaging, cherry-picking, or pooling Run A and Run B
fixed the holdout size at 20 scenarios by 4 turns
raised dimension_attribution_negative from 4 to 6 turns and required six distinct dimension-confusion families rather than paraphrases of the development sentence
reframed the composition minimums as coverage constraints rather than turn quotas and added episode-naturalness rules
required per-operation numerator and denominator reporting for every correction and retract metric
restated what Analysis B proves as a deterministic interpretation-layer effect rather than a whole-method causal effect
declared provider-variance decomposition out of scope under the single-run design and recorded the pre-registered option that would make it measurable
fixed the holdout authoring sequence and forbade executing v1.4 or reading its output while authoring
recorded that the next method change forks to v1.5 instead of editing frozen v1.4
amendment_history.reason: The protocol is amendable only while no holdout data and no run exist. Both conditions held at amendment time.

primary_question: Can SEGSE v1.4 reduce false current-turn state updates while preserving genuine value and scope corrections and the resulting accumulated state?

A_end_to_end.purpose: measure the frozen method as deployed
A_end_to_end.upstream: live gpt-4o-mini, temperature 0, one call per attempted turn

B_fixed_upstream_paired.purpose: isolate the deterministic interpretation layer from LLM run variation
B_fixed_upstream_paired.upstream: raw structured proposals recorded during Analysis A
B_fixed_upstream_paired.valid_because: v1.3 and v1.4 share the prompt text and output schema byte-for-byte
B_fixed_upstream_paired.supports: the deterministic interpretation-layer effect: how much the downstream contract change moves the outcome when the same LLM proposal is given, paired per turn and bootstrappable over scenarios
does_not_support: the causal effect of the whole v1.4 method
how often the upstream emits the proposal that makes the contract matter

claim_boundaries.A_end_to_end: the actual confirmatory performance of the whole frozen v1.4 system
claim_boundaries.B_fixed_upstream: the effect of the v1.3 to v1.4 deterministic contract change under an identical raw proposal

C_test_retest_provider_stability.purpose: measure how much the identical frozen method moves on identical data because of provider nondeterminism
C_test_retest_provider_stability.upstream: a second live run of the same frozen v1.4 method on the same holdout
C_test_retest_provider_stability.supports: the provider-level stability of the frozen method
does_not_support: any primary PASS or FAIL decision
a better or averaged performance number
a retroactive redefinition of Run A

claim_boundaries.A_end_to_end: the actual confirmatory performance of the whole frozen v1.4 system
claim_boundaries.B_fixed_upstream: the effect of the v1.3 to v1.4 deterministic contract change under an identical raw proposal
claim_boundaries.C_test_retest: the provider-level nondeterminism of the frozen method on identical data

provider_variation_decomposition.reason_it_needs_a_second_run: No live v1.3 run on the holdout exists, so an end-to-end version difference is not computable. Provider variation can only be observed by repeating the identical frozen method on the identical data.
provider_variation_decomposition.known_magnitude_from_development: raw proposals differed on 5 of 24 development turns at temperature 0
provider_variation_decomposition.forbidden_inference: attributing any holdout difference to provider variance without a measurement of it

run_roles.governing_statement: Run A is the sole primary confirmatory evaluation. Run B is a pre-registered test-retest analysis of provider-level nondeterminism and shall not replace, average with, or retroactively redefine Run A.

execution_order_rule.statement: Run A and Run B execute back to back before any result of either is opened.
ordered: do not open Run A results
execution_order_rule.reason: Deciding whether to do Run B after seeing Run A would be a selection bias.

forbidden_operations: averaging Run A and Run B into one reported number
pooling Run A and Run B as independent samples for a confidence interval
replacing a Run A number with a Run B number
using Run B to redefine the Run A decision after the fact
run_roles.pooling_rule: Run A and Run B are repeated measurements of the same 80 turns. They are used only for stability analysis, never as independent samples.

primary_outcome.name: final_dst_closeness_to_gold_state
primary_outcome.statement: How close is the final accumulated DialogueState produced by frozen v1.4 to the frozen Gold State, and is it closer than the v1.3 contract on the identical raw proposals?
primary_outcome.comparison_unit: the active final-state token set: hard facts as canonical_id|hard|normalized_value, qualitative facts as canonical_id|scope, superseded facts excluded

closeness_measures.error_tokens: |predicted symmetric-difference gold| per episode, that is FP + FN, lower is better
closeness_measures.jaccard: |predicted intersect gold| / |predicted union gold| per episode, 1.0 means identical
closeness_measures.micro_f1: token-level precision, recall, F1 pooled across episodes

exact_match_role.reason_demoted: Exact match is all-or-nothing and has poor resolution. On the development fixture v1.3 scored 0/6 exact while its mean Jaccard was .569, and both v1.4 misses were single-token, one of them from provider variance. A single token should not move the headline.
exact_match_role.reported_as: strictest cut, exact match count out of 20

primary_outcome.why_graded: The research claim is that false updates fall while genuine corrections survive, which is a graded movement of the final state toward gold, not a demand for token-perfect episodes.

supporting_decompositions.where_it_fails: per-episode token-level false positives and false negatives with their origin cause
supporting_decompositions.turn_level: turnwise accumulated state precision, recall, F1, labelled persistence-amplified
supporting_decompositions.per_decision: material State Diff and material operation precision, recall, F1

paired_improvement_primary.name: final_state_closeness_improvement_over_v13
paired_improvement_primary.why_this_analysis: The holdout has no live v1.3 run, but Analysis B replays the identical recorded raw proposals through the v1.3 and the v1.4 deterministic pipelines, which yields a paired v1.3 final state on the same data with zero extra LLM calls.
paired_improvement_primary.what_it_isolates: the deterministic contract change only, with the LLM held identical by construction
reported: paired bootstrap 95 percent confidence interval over the 20 episodes

reference_ladder_optional.description: The base SEGSE pipeline without the v1.3 and v1.4 repairs can be replayed on the same proposals to give a three-point ladder. Offline and free, but not required for the primary claim.
reference_ladder_optional.note: If enabled it must be enabled before the run.

pass_requires_all_of.paired_final_state_closeness_improves: mean per-episode Jaccard improvement over v1.3 is positive and the paired bootstrap 95 percent CI lower bound is above 0
pass_requires_all_of.regression_is_bounded: at most 2 of 20 episodes get worse in error-token count
pass_requires_all_of.improvement_is_broad: at least 8 of 20 episodes improve in error-token count
pass_requires_all_of.correction_recall_recovered: combined value and scope correction recall is strictly greater than the v1.3 paired value on the same proposals

reported_without_a_threshold: absolute scenario final-state micro precision, recall, F1
decision_rule.why_no_absolute_threshold: No untouched measurement of this method exists, so any absolute bar would be invented rather than justified. The pre-registered decision therefore rests on the paired improvement and the guardrails, and the absolute numbers are reported descriptively.
forbidden: declaring success from exact match alone
declaring success from an aggregate F1 alone
moving a threshold after seeing the result

guardrail_rule: A guardrail regression fails the confirmatory claim even when a primary metric improves.

development_calibration_reference.purpose: context for why the primary is graded, not a threshold and not evidence
development_calibration_reference.observation: v1.3 scored 0/6 exact yet .569 mean Jaccard, and both v1.4 misses were single-token with one caused by provider variance. Exact match alone would have reported v1.3 as a total failure and would let one token move the v1.4 headline.

not_evaluable.provenance_accuracy: the evaluator does not compute explicit/implicit/inferred agreement
not_evaluable.product_relevance: out of scope for a state experiment
not_evaluable.review_relevance: out of scope for a state experiment
not_evaluable.human_perceived_quality: no human grades are collected in this protocol

persistence_amplification_disclosure.statement: Final-state improvement is amplified by persistence across subsequent turns. One corrected event repairs every later snapshot of its scenario, so accumulated-state deltas exceed the number of event-level decisions that produced them. Material delta and material operation metrics are the per-decision view and must be quoted with any accumulated-state claim.

freeze_before_execution: gold policy lane and question target
holdout_authoring_rules.explicitly_forbidden_sentence: A microSD slot that accepts large cards would be convenient.
holdout_authoring_rules.expansion_storage_family_gold_rule: no note_taking event and no storage_capacity event
machine_checked_before_freeze: declared hard filters equal the deterministic query generator on the gold state
declared policy lane and question target equal the deterministic policy
gold evidence text is an exact current-utterance substring
gold and forbidden IDs do not overlap

holdout_size.rationale: Matches the scale of the earlier official and confirmatory tablet holdouts so comparisons are straightforward, and leaves headroom above the 56 constrained turns. A smaller set would let one or two cases dominate value-correction, scope-correction, and retract or reactivation recall.

composition_note: These are minimum coverage counts, not a template list. The holdout is 20 coherent four-turn shopping episodes that happen to cover these transitions, not 80 independent unit tests. An episode built from one family only is rejected.

episode_design_rules.forbidden_shape: an 80-entry list of independent failure templates

dimension_attribution_negative_design.purpose: a pre-declared generalization test of a residual failure family already found in development, not an adversarial attempt to fail v1.4
dimension_attribution_negative_design.requirement: six dimension-confusion opportunities across six different families, each testing whether a real current-utterance signal is over-canonicalized into an unrelated subjective facet or preference ID
dimension_attribution_negative_design.forbidden: six paraphrases of the development microSD sentence, or six turns that repeat one family
dimension_attribution_negative_design.gold_rule: gold contains no preference or facet ID that the utterance does not lexically support; the unsupported IDs are listed in forbidden_event_ids

headline_is_graded_closeness_and_paired_.format_example: Final-state error tokens per episode 1.35 -> 0.45 versus the v1.3 contract on identical proposals; 14/20 episodes improved, 0 worsened; mean Jaccard .62 -> .88; exact match 11/20
must_be_accompanied_by: per-episode error tokens and Jaccard for both contracts
the count of episodes improved, unchanged, and worsened
the failing episodes with their token-level FP and FN
the origin cause of every final-state false positive

per_operation_numerator_and_denominator.reason: 80 turns is still small for correction metrics; an aggregate rate hides how few targets support it

ordered_steps: annotate gold events, material operations, and accumulated state
authoring_sequence.rationale: Running v1.4 on a candidate utterance to see whether it behaves converts that utterance into development data. Gold must come from the contract, never from an observed output.

execution_contract.rerun_allowed_only_when: no turn produced a scored output

next_change_policy.reason: Folding a dimension gate into v1.4 would blur which failure layer v1.4 resolved.

secondary_question.question: Is dimension attribution now the dominant residual error?
secondary_question.evidence: the distribution of Final FP origin causes on the holdout, with carryover_to_update separated from novel_extraction and incorrect_value_or_scope
secondary_question.consequence_if_confirmed: v1.5 becomes a semantic dimension grounding / attribution gate as an independent intervention

interpretation_limits: v1.4 was tuned on an exposed development fixture; development numbers never evidence generalization.
The dimension-attribution weakness is known and unfixed. Exposure by the holdout is a recorded limitation, not a reason to patch and re-run.

Analysis B holds the upstream identical, so it measures the deterministic interpretation-layer effect only. It is not the causal effect of the whole method and it says nothing about how often the upstream emits the proposal that makes the contract matter.
Provider variation is not estimated on the holdout, so no holdout difference may be attributed to it.
Eighty turns is small for correction metrics. Every correction and retract number is reported as a numerator over a denominator.
Passing supports a state-update correctness claim only, not recommendation quality or human relevance.
